newsitem.title: GERMANY: Programme for Global 24 forex conference - July 1.
newsitem.headline: Programme for Global 24 forex conference - July 1.

text.p: The following is a summary of the programme for the Global 24 international forex conference taking place on July 1 on the theme "European Monetary Union, the Global Impact".
TUESDAY, JULY 1

FRANKFURT - Deutsche Boerse AG Supervisory Board Chairman Rolf Breuer gives address at Introduction to Global 24 "European Monetary Union - The Global Impact" conference with global videolink to Frankfurt, Milan, New York, Paris and Tokyo. 0730 GMT

FRANKFURT, MILAN, NEW YORK, PARIS, TOKYO - Wall Street Journal Washington Bureau Chief moderates panel discussion with global videolink with European Commission President Jacques Santer (in Frankfurt), Italian Treasury Undersecretary Piero Giarda (in Milan), Former French Prime Minister and City of Lyon Mayor Raymond Barre (in Paris) and Industrial Bank of Japan Chairman Yoh Kurasawa (in Tokyo). 0745 GMT

TOKYO - Ambassador and Head of Delegation of the European Commission Joern Keck, European Parliament Subcommittee on Monetary Affairs Chairman Christa Randzio-Plath, Deutsche Bank AG management board members Josef Ackermann and Gerd Haeusler take part in panel discussion entitled "The implications of the euro for the international financial markets". 0800 GMT

FRANKFURT - Austrian Finance Minister Rudolf Edlinger, Irish Finance Minister Charlie McCreevy and German Finance Minister Theo Waigel take part in panel discussion entitled "How to ensure coherent European economic policies". 0930 GMT

MILAN - Fiat Honorary Chairman Giovanni Agnelli, European Commissioner Mario Monti and Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Chairman Mario Sarcinelli take part in panel discussion entitled "Risks and benefits of the Euro on the Italian economy". 0930 GMT

TOKYO - Boston Consulting Group Senior Vice President Koichi Hori, Nomura Research Institute Chairman Koichi Minaguchi and Keio University Business & Commerce Professor Makoto Utsumi take part in panel discussion entitled "What does the euro mean to the Japanese". 1100 GMT
TOKYO - Industrial Bank of Japan Chairman Yoh Kurosawa makes final remarks at end of Global 24 conference in Tokyo. 1200 GMT

FRANKFURT, LONDON, NEW YORK - AMUE President and Societe General de Belgique President Chairman Etienne Davignon, Union of Industrial and Employers' Confederations of Europe Francois Perigot, Fiat Chairman Cesare Romiti (all in Frankfurt), Confederation of British Industry Director-General Adair Turner (in London) and Boston Consulting Group Chief Executive Officer and President John Clarkeson (in New York) take part in panel discussion with global videolink entitled "The euro is coming: what does it mean for business worldwide?". 1215 GMT

FRANKFURT - Metra Corporation President and Chief Executive Officer Georg Ehrnrooth, Philips Electronics Vice Chairman Dudley Eustace, Spanish High Council of Chambers of Commerce, Industry and Shipping President Carlos Ferrer, Deutsche Bank AG Supervisory Board Chairman Hilmar Kopper take part in panel discussion entitled "The euro is coming: what consequences will it have for the Europeans?". 1330 GMT

MILAN - ENI Managing Director Franco Bernabe, Alleanza Assicurazioni Managing Director Alfonso Desiata, IMI Chief Executive Officer Rainer Masera and Consob Supervisory Authority on Italian Market Chairman Tommaso Padoa Schioppa take part in panel discussion entitled "The euro and the globalization of financial markets - The perspectives for Italy". 1330 GMT

LONDON - Deutsche Bank AG management board member Ronaldo Schmitz, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson Vice Chairman Michael Jenkins, Morgan Stanley Executive Chairman David Walker, Managing Director and Global Head of Business Strategy at NatWest Markets Pauline Neville-Jones and Boston Consulting Group Senior Vice President David Hall take part in panel discussion entitled "The impact of the euro on European Banking". 1330 GMT

FRANKFURT, LONDON, MILAN, NEW YORK, PARIS, TOKYO - Deutsche Boerse AG management board member Joerg Franke, London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange President Daniel Hodson, Italian Stock Exchange Chairman Francesco Cesarini, New York Stock Exchange Chairman Richard Grasso, Paris Bourse Chairman Jean-Francois Theodore and Tokyo Stock Exchange Chairman Senior Managing Directo Yoshiaki Kaneko take part in panel discussion with global videolink entitled "The euro and the international securities business". 1500 GMT
FRANKFURT - European Commission member Yves-Thibault de Silguy gives speech on "Preparing for the Euro: Where do we stand 500 days before the deadline?" (Global Videolink). 1615 GMT

FRANKFURT - Head of the Dutch central bank and president designate of the European Monetary Institute Wim Duisenberg, Governor of the Bank of England Eddie George, German Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer and Governor of the Bank of France Jean-Claude Trichet take part in panel discussion "Europe united behind a single currency: will it be a credible and sustainable world currency?" with global videolink to London, Milan, New York and Paris. 1630 GMT
FRANKFURT - Wall Street Journal Washington Bureau Chief makes global summary and Deutsche Boerse AG Supervisory Board Chairman makes final remarks at Global 24 conference. 1800 GMT
MILAN - Italian Stock Exchange Chairman Francesco Cesarini makes final remarks at Global 24 conference. 1800 GMT
LONDON - Confederation of British Industry Director-General Adair Turner makes final remarks at Global 24 conference. 1800 GMT
